history.titleZh: 奇特的AI芯片演示用黄油凸显新芯片比竞品运行温度低40度
history.descriptionZh:
在AI数据中心因高功耗和散热问题引发全球争议之际，韩国芯片初创公司DEEPX试图以“让AI芯片本身运行更冷”为卖点。CNBC近期报道指出，现代数据中心的设计、成本和资源消耗深受发热处理器影响，数据中心扩张已在商业、环境和政治层面引发担忧，甚至出现数百人抗议数据中心的活动。DEEPX用一项颇具噱头的“黄油热基准”展示其DX-M1处理器的低发热特性：在并排测试中，未具名竞争对手的AI芯片几秒内就能让一块黄油滋滋融化，而DX-M1上的黄油仍保持固态。DEEPX CEO Kim Nok-won称，与竞品相比温差可达25至40多摄氏度，并强调各芯片处理“相同AI工作负载”。

DEEPX的核心主张是通过超低功耗NPU设计降低芯片自身发热，从而减少对庞大供电和冷却系统的依赖。不过，报道也指出该对比缺少关键信息：没有披露各处理器完成测试工作负载的速度、功耗和时钟频率。降低功耗或频率本就可以让任何芯片变冷，PC玩家也常通过降压降频改善GPU发热和噪音，因此仅凭黄油是否融化不足以证明能效优势。DX-M1是面向边缘计算和机器人应用的NPU，并非与数据中心机架中的Nvidia Blackwell、Rubin等大功耗GPU直接竞争。

产品进展方面，DX-M1 NPU自2025年8月起在三星5nm工艺上生产，并已获得约1330万美元订单。DEEPX计划推进下一代DX-M2 AI芯片，基于三星2nm工艺，目标2027年下半年量产。文章认为，这类低功耗NPU的应用场景主要是边缘计算和机器人，因此黄油测试与CNBC报道中耗电巨大的Nvidia GPU机架并不在同一赛道，有一定转移注意力之嫌。未来，如果数百上千台高发热Nvidia GPU及其液冷系统能被更冷的定制加速器替代，可能有助于缓解针对AI数据中心的环境与政治反弹；但DX-M1乃至DX-M2并不足以在该数据中心GPU市场展开竞争。

CNBC报道还提到SK海力士的iHBM方案，其中“i”代表“集成冷却元件”，旨在实现下一代低功耗、低发热内存；CoolIT也在尝试让水冷更接近发热硅片。这些方向共同反映出，AI算力基础设施的竞争正从单纯性能扩展到能效和散热。DEEPX的演示凸显了低功耗边缘AI芯片的潜力，但其实际能效和性能仍需更完整的基准数据验证。

history.title: Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI Review: Slim OLED gaming that doesn't last long
history.description: The Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI pairs strong gaming performance, a 240 Hz OLED display, and good upgradeability but compromises the package with relatively short battery life.
history.content: Not everyone wants a hulking gaming laptop. Some prefer something stealthier. Acer’s Predator Helios Neo 16S AI aims for portability but still packs a Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus processor and Nvidia RTX 5070 Ti graphics into a sub-five-pound package. It also includes plenty of ports and a beautiful 240 Hz OLED display. That hardware gives it plenty to work with, but the question remains whether the Helios Neo 16S AI can still deliver solid gaming performance while being portable.Design of the Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AIAcer’s obsidian black chassis maintains the look of the Predator series – angular, dark, and visible in the dark with its illuminated lid logo. At 14.05 x 10.85 x 0.74 inches and 4.85 pounds, it’s respectably trim for a gaming laptop, though the Gigabyte Aero X16 (14 x 9.9 x 0.78 inches, 4.2 pounds) and the HyperX Omen 15 (13.5 x 9.96 x 0.93 inches, 4.89 pounds) both have about an inch less depth since neither use a rear thermal shelf like Acer.Acer Predator Helios Neo 16s AI at Best Buy for $2,774.99 Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original The build quality is decent – both the chassis and lid show little flex. The stamped aluminum panels on the lid bottom and chassis lid aren’t ultra-premium but still beat plastic. One downside is that the metal shows fingerprints easily, which are difficult to clean off.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Acer provides an impressive port variety across three sides: Thunderbolt 4, three USB-A 3.2, USB-C 3.2, HDMI 2.1, 2.5 Gbps Ethernet, a MicroSD card reader, and an audio jack. The rear ports conveniently leave cables out of sight.Inside, the laptop offers Wi-Fi 6E, which isn’t as modern as it could be, though the Killer AX1675i card and accompanying Killer Ethernet jack offer simultaneous network connections via Killer Doubleshot Pro for gamers that want to ensure network priority for the games over one connection and all other apps over the other. It’s also notable that Acer includes a zippered, padded travel sleeve. The game remained all-around playable, though it did require using DLSS to achieve these framerates at native 2560 x 1600 with High settings.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsOur comparison systems for this Acer are Gigabyte’s Aero X16 (Ryzen AI 7 350, RTX 5070 85W, $1,899.99 when tested, $1,499.99 as of this writing) and HyperX’s Omen 15 (Core Ultra 9 386H, RTX 5070 85W, $2,099.99 when tested, about $3,159.99 as of this writing).Comparisons will focus on the 1920 x 1080 results, but we also included numbers at each laptop’s native resolution: 2560 x 1600 for the Acer and Gigabyte while the HP uses 2880 x 1800. Much of that has to do with its higher-wattage RTX 5070 Ti, though its Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus processor is also more modern.In Shadow of the Tomb Raider (Highest detail preset), Acer’s 125 FPS at 1080p was on par with the HyperX (126 FPS), though it dominated at its 1600p native resolution, with 76 FPS against Gigabyte’s 60 FPS and HyperX’s 64 FPS.Acer’s advantage continued in Far Cry 6 (Ultra), where it produced 122 FPS to Gigabyte’s 85 FPS and HyperX’s 107 FPS at native resolution. The lead narrowed in Red Dead Redemption 2 (Medium) where Acer and Gigabyte practically tied at 1080p and were within a few FPS at native (52 FPS for Acer and 49 FPS for Gigabyte). The HyperX remained behind.The Acer also demonstrated markedly better performance in Cyberpunk 2077 (Ray Tracing Ultra) particularly at native resolution, where its 21 FPS outran Gigabyte (17 FPS) and HyperX (5 FPS).In Forza Horizon 6 (Extreme), Acer’s 72 FPS at 1080p was strangely lower than HyperX’s 80 FPS, but the results flipped at native, where Acer’s 60 FPS was considerably ahead of HyperX’s 51 FPS.While not a powerhouse, the Predator Helios Neo 16S AI demonstrates competent gaming performance at its 2560 x 1600 native resolution. Crucially, the extra depth from Acer’s thermal shelf design lets its GPU draw 115 W, considerably more than its Gigabyte and HyperX competitorsWe test the sustained performance of gaming laptops running 15 loops of the Metro: Exodus stress test, simulating half an hour of gaming. During the test, the Predator Helios Neo 16S AI averaged 86.82 FPS across all runs. The variance was less than one FPS between runs, indicating stable thermal performance. The Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus ran at an average of 2.94 GHz on its P-cores, 2.16 GHz on its E-cores, and had an average temperature of 73 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, the RTX 5070 Ti averaged 1.622 GHz and 74 C.Productivity Performance on the Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AIOur Predator Helios Neo 16S AI features a Core Ultra 9 290HX processor, 16GB of dual-channel DDR5-6400 memory, and a 1TB PCIe 4.0 SSD. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original The Acer’s Core Ultra 9 290HX produced strong numbers in Geekbench. Its single-core score of 3,349 and multi-core score of 19,313 were well ahead of the Ryzen AI 7 350-powered Gigabyte (2,916 and 14,074) and Core Ultra 9 386H-powered HyperX (2,857 and 15,916). This continued into our 4K-to-1080p Handbrake transcoding testing, which Acer dominated with 2 minutes and 30 seconds. The Gigabyte (3:54) and HyperX (3:39) weren’t even close.Acer also produced solid numbers in our 25GB file transfer test, averaging 2,034.84 MBps next to Gigabyte’s1,480.57 MBps and HyperX’s far slower 999.57 MBps.Overall, this Acer is very capable for almost any kind of use. Multitasking will be limited by 16GB of RAM, but Acer sells versions of this laptop with 32GB and it can be upgraded after purchase.Display on the Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AIOnce glance at this Acer’s display leaves no doubt it’s a key selling point. Its OLED panel technology creates exceptionally vivid colors matched by excellent brightness, and its glossy surface gives it an almost liquid appearance. The 2560 x 1600 resolution is a good balance between detail and what the system’s RTX 5070 Ti graphics card can drive in today’s games. Gamers will also appreciate the smooth 240 Hz refresh rate and Nvidia G-Sync support. (As we’ll see in the battery life section, the screen only supports 240 Hz, resulting in higher-than-expected power consumption.)Watching nature documentaries on National Geographic, I noted the vibrant colors of tropical scenes and the pitch blacks of the depths of the sea. Gaming was equally immersive – 007 First Light felt supremely fluid and looked sharp. I could even make out the writing on character’s uniform badges without zooming. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The Acer’s display covered a healthy 82.7% of the DCI-P3 color gamut, matching the Gigabyte, although it wasn’t quite in the same league as the HyperX, which also used an OLED panel. It also didn’t match the HyperX in brightness, but with a peak of 372.4 nits in SDR, the Acer boasts solid brightness for OLED. Our 40% HDR testing revealed up to an impressive 608 nits of brightness.Keyboard and Touchpad on the Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AIAcer’s keyboard offers a satisfying feel, with ample throw and cushioning without feeling rubbery. In MonkeyType, I reached 116 words per minute with 99% accuracy on my first try, a great result for me on any laptop. The Acer Key app lets you customize the user-customizable key above the plus key, which is handy for creating one-press access to a favorite app or site.Though the keyboard doesn't feature per-key backlighting, its four RGB zones can be set to many patterns and colors in the PredatorSense app. When changing lighting settings, the app initially says they’re controlled by Windows Dynamic Lighting, but that isn’t the case since Dynamic Lighting says no compatible devices are detected. But once dismissing the warning in PredatorSense, the app provides intuitive if limited control over the zones and lid logo. Each zone can be assigned a static lighting effect or the entire keyboard set in a dynamic pattern: breathing, neon, wave, ripple, combo, snake, and disco, with customizable speed, direction, and brightness. Settings can be stored in profiles.Acer also did well with the large touchpad, which offers predictable clicking and my fingers glided smoothly over the matte surface. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Audio on the Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AIAudio performance isn’t a strong point for the Neo 16S AI. Twin speakers embedded in the palm rest barely have enough volume for casual listening, with average clarity and thin bass. In Phil Collins’ “Don’t Lose My Number”, drum hits sounded flat and vocals were somewhat muted.The speakers are better-suited gaming, offering a decent sense of direction because of their placement on either side of the palm rest, but lack of bass and volume means you'll want a headset. The DTS:X app offers equalizers – without them, the sound is quite tinny. I had the best results leaving the equalizer on Auto.Upgradeability of the Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AIWith ten Torx T6 screws securing the bottom cover, Acer doesn’t make it easy to get inside the Predator Helios Neo 16S AI. Removing the screws is the easy part – finding an entry point for my plastic pry tool provided harder. I eventually found one at the front corners of the chassis by using mild force. The fact that the side vents are part of the bottom cover compounds the difficulty – I needed to find an opening for my pry tool above those as well. The clips made cringeworthy snapping sounds as they were released, though surprisingly, none cracked off. Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original The effort is not for naught – Acer offers solid upgradeability, with two SODIMM slots under the black plastic cover in the middle, plus an M.2 2280 SSD slot and M.2 2230 wireless card slot. The battery is also replaceable.Battery Life on the Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AIOur battery testing consists of web browsing, running OpenGL tests, and streaming videos with the screen at 150 nits while connected to Wi-Fi. The Predator underwhelmed here despite having a large 92 WHr battery – the HyperX laptop outlasted it by almost two hours and the Gigabyte nearly two and a half hours. Most of the blame goes to Acer’s decision to use a screen locked at 240 Hz; more advanced displays would support a variable refresh rate or at least allow it to be lowered to 60 Hz. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Heat on the Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AIWe measure laptop surface temperatures during 15 loops of the Metro: Exodus stress test. During the test, the Acer’s temperatures peaked at 103 degrees F between the keyboard G and H keys, 81 F on the touchpad, and a toasty 129 F on bottom-center. Fan noise is audible particularly while gaming; hearing softer sounds in games will require using a headset. For daily use, the laptop hardly makes any noise.Webcam on the Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AIAcer’s 1080p webcam offers a decently sharp picture – I could make out details in my facial hair and eyes from a few feet away. Highlights are also handled reasonably well. It lacks a physical privacy shutter or e-shutter, but it does have infrared (IR) for facial recognition.Software and Warranty on the Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AIPredatorSense remains the prominent app on Acer’s Predator gaming laptops. On the Predator Helios Neo 16S AI, it offers power settings, system monitoring, updates, and system settings. Power profiles include quiet, balanced (the default), performance, and turbo. Performance mode indicates it overclocks the CPU and GPU, but doesn’t specify details, while turbo appears to be performance mode but with the fan speeds maxed.The app’s settings let you disable Nvidia Optimus, set up optimized battery charging, a bluelight shield, and toggle a 30-second keyboard backlighting timeout. Fan control is possible, though the custom option only allows you to set the RPM, not a curve. Most of the settings above plus lighting effects and a sound equalizer can be saved in scenario profiles.Acer loads many more apps than PredatorSense – too many: Acer Assist, Acer Chroma Tune, Acer Intelligence Space, Acer LiveArt, Acer documents, Acer Jumpstart, Acer Legal Information, Acer My Key, Acer Purified Voice Console, Acer PurifiedView, and Acer QuickPanel create a lengthy list under the Start Menu’s “A” section. Many of them are simply links to the Windows Store.Some of the apps actually installed are useful, like Acer My Key mentioned earlier. Others could be: Acer Intelligence Space provides many AI-driven features like a meeting assistant, an image generator, a media search tool, and a game assistant that claims to automatically change the color of your crosshair for maximum visibility. I didn’t test all these out – they aren’t specific to the Predator Helios Neo 16S AI – but it seems that they could add value if you’re not already vested in other AI services.There’s also a decent amount of bloatware, including a McAfee trial, a Dropbox promotion, and Forge of Empires. While easily uninstalled, they simply don’t belong on a laptop this expensive.Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI ConfigurationsOur Predator Helios Neo 16S AI includes a Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus CPU, Nvidia RTX 5070 Ti graphics card, 16GB of dual-channel RAM, a 1TB PCIe 4.0 solid-state drive, and a 16-inch 2560 x 1600 OLED display with a 240 Hz refresh rate. It retails for $2,774.99 from Best Buy, though I did see it briefly drop to $1,999.99 during my review period.Best Buy also offers a 32GB version for $3,199.99, but it was discounted to $2,459.99 during our review period, making it less expensive than our model. Pricing is always in flux with the ongoing memory shortages, but Acer’s list prices are in line with market expectations. At Best Buy, many RTX 5070 Ti models hover around the same price as our model and many are pricier.Acer also lists a $2,099.99 model on its site with 16GB of RAM, a 1TB SSD, and an RTX 5060, though I didn’t find this model for sale.Bottom LineThe Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI delivers on most of its thin-and-light gaming promise. Its RTX 5070 Ti provides solid gaming performance on its beautiful 240 Hz OLED display, and it follows up with a comfortable keyboard and touchpad, useful port selection, and solid upgradeability.The trouble is that its portability is undermined by its below average battery life, an ironic shortcoming for a thin-and-light laptop. Audible gaming fans and lackluster speakers are further compromises, but the limited unplugged runtime is the one that those seeking a more portable package ought to be most concerned about.But if you’re after a relatively slim gaming laptop to take between places where you can plug in, the Helios Neo 16S AI is an otherwise appealing package.Acer Predator Helios Neo 16s AI : Price Comparison $2,774.99View No price informationCheck AmazonWe check over 250 million products every day for the best pricespowered by

history.titleZh: 宏碁掠夺者Helios Neo 16S AI评测：轻薄OLED游戏本，续航不给力
history.descriptionZh:
宏碁Predator Helios Neo 16S AI是一款主打“轻薄化”的高性能游戏本，试图回应部分用户既想要便携、又不愿放弃高规格游戏硬件的需求。该机采用曜石黑、棱角分明的Predator家族设计，机身尺寸14.05×10.85×0.74英寸、重4.85磅，在游戏本中相对轻薄；但为容纳后部散热架，机身深度比技嘉Aero X16和HyperX Omen 15多约1英寸。机身与顶盖为冲压铝材，刚性尚可但容易沾染指纹。接口是其亮点：提供Thunderbolt 4、3个USB-A 3.2、USB-C 3.2、HDMI 2.1、2.5Gbps以太网、MicroSD读卡器和音频接口，后置接口便于理线；无线为Killer Wi-Fi 6E AX1675i，并支持Killer Doubleshot Pro双网络连接，可将游戏流量与其他应用分流。核心配置为Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus处理器、Nvidia GeForce RTX 5070 Ti（12GB GDDR7、最高115W图形功耗）、16GB DDR5-6400双通道内存、1TB PCIe 4.0 SSD，以及16英寸16:10 OLED屏，分辨率2560×1600、刷新率240Hz并支持G-Sync。售价为2774.99美元，另有32GB内存版本标价3199.99美元，评测期间曾打折至2459.99美元；宏碁官网还列出2099.99美元的RTX 5060版本，但未找到实际销售。

评测的核心问题是：这款较薄的游戏本能否在便携的同时保持稳定游戏性能。答案是基本可以，但前提是插电使用。其RTX 5070 Ti最高115W，明显高于对比机型技嘉Aero X16和HyperX Omen 15的85W RTX 5070，加上更新的Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus，整体游戏表现显著领先。在《007 First Light》中，2560×1600原生分辨率、高画质并开启DLSS时，多数场景约65—75 FPS，开阔区域可超过100 FPS，整体可玩。对比测试中，《古墓丽影：暗影》最高预设下1080p为125 FPS，与HyperX的126 FPS接近，但在原生1600p下以76 FPS领先技嘉的60 FPS和HyperX的64 FPS；《孤岛惊魂6》Ultra原生分辨率下为122 FPS，对手分别为85和107 FPS；《赛博朋克2077》光线追踪Ultra原生分辨率下为21 FPS，对手为17和5 FPS；《极限竞速：地平线6》Extreme下1080p为72 FPS，低于HyperX的80 FPS，但原生分辨率下以60 FPS反超HyperX的51 FPS；《荒野大镖客2》Medium下与技嘉接近，原生分辨率为52 FPS对49 FPS。总体看，它在2560×1600原生分辨率下具备合格且稳定的游戏能力，后部散热架换来的机身深度使其GPU功耗更高，是性能优势的重要原因。Metro: Exodus 15轮压力测试中平均86.82 FPS，轮间波动不足1 FPS，CPU的P核平均2.94GHz、E核2.16GHz、平均温度73℃，GPU平均1.622GHz、74℃，显示持续散热较稳定。

生产力方面，Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus表现强劲：Geekbench单核3349、多核19313，明显高于Ryzen AI 7 350的2916/14074和Core Ultra 9 386H的2857/15916；Handbrake 4K转1080p耗时2分30秒，对手为3分54秒和3分39秒；25GB文件传输平均2034.84 MBps，对手为1480.57和999.57 MBps。16GB内存会限制重度多任务，但该机支持选购32GB版本，且可后期升级。屏幕是重要卖点：OLED面板色彩鲜艳、黑色纯净、 glossy表面观感通透，2560×1600兼顾细节与RTX 5070 Ti可驱动的游戏负载，240Hz和G-Sync提升流畅度；DCI-P3覆盖82.7%，与技嘉相当但不及HyperX OLED，SDR峰值亮度372.4尼特，40% HDR测试可达608尼特。不过屏幕仅支持240Hz、不能降至60Hz或可变刷新，成为续航偏短的主要原因。

键盘手感良好，键程与缓冲充足，MonkeyType测试首次达到116词/分、99%准确率；加号上方按键可通过Acer Key自定义，四区RGB而非单键背光，可在PredatorSense中设置多种灯效。触控板面积大、点击可预期、表面顺滑。音频是短板：掌托两侧双扬声器音量仅够 casual listening，清晰度一般、低音薄，游戏时定位尚可但建议使用耳机，DTS:X均衡器设为Auto效果较好。可升级性方面，底部10颗T6螺丝且卡扣较难拆，侧通风口与底盖一体增加难度，但内部提供两个SODIMM插槽、一个M.2 2280 SSD位、一个M.2 2230无线网卡位，电池也可更换。续航令人失望：92Wh电池在150尼特、Wi-Fi网页浏览/OpenGL/视频流测试中，HyperX多出近2小时、技嘉多出近2.5小时；对轻薄游戏本而言这是讽刺性短板。表面温度在Metro压力测试中，键盘G/H键间峰值103°F，触控板81°F，底部中心129°F；游戏时风扇可闻，日常使用安静。1080p IR摄像头画面较清晰、高光处理合理，无物理或电子隐私快门，但支持红外人脸识别。

软件方面，PredatorSense提供安静、均衡、性能、Turbo功率模式、系统监控、更新和设置；性能模式称会超频CPU/GPU但未说明细节，Turbo疑似性能模式加风扇满转；可禁用Nvidia Optimus、设置优化电池充电、蓝光护盾、30秒键盘背光超时，风扇可自定义RPM但无曲线，场景配置可保存灯效和均衡器。预装软件偏多，不少只是微软商店链接；Acer Intelligence Space提供会议助手、图像生成、媒体搜索和可自动改变准星颜色的游戏助手等AI功能，可能有用，但同时存在McAfee试用、Dropbox推广和《Forge of Empires》等臃肿软件，对如此高价机型并不合适。

综合来看，Predator Helios Neo 16S AI兑现了多数“轻薄游戏本”承诺：RTX 5070 Ti在漂亮的240Hz OLED屏上提供扎实游戏性能，键盘触控舒适、接口实用、升级性不错；但续航低于平均，削弱了便携意义，游戏风扇噪音和扬声器表现也是妥协。它更适合在多个可插电地点之间携带、以游戏和生产力为主且能接受插电使用的用户；若追求真正长续航的移动游戏体验，则需谨慎考虑。

history.title: Lawyer builds private AI server with eight used Nvidia V100 GPUs
history.description: A lawyer runs DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on eight used 2018-era Nvidia V100 GPUs at up to 215 tokens/s, keeping case files in the office.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 12 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A lawyer posted on Reddit about their private AI server built from eight used 2018-era Nvidia Tesla V100 data center GPUs so case files never have to leave the office. With two 4-card SXM2 NVLink boards, four PEX switches, and SlimSAS cables everywhere — plus one burnt power connector — the builder now runs the open DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model with every expert in GPU memory, at up to 215 tokens per second. The four-GPU boards cost about $2,400 apiece when the builder bought them.Lawyer's V100 homelab, update: two 4-card SXM2 NVLink boards, four PEX switches, SlimSAS everywhere, one burnt power connector, and a 250 GB model running entirely in VRAM at 200+ tok/s from r/homelabThe eight Tesla V100-SXM2-32GB cards, each with 32GB of HBM2 at 900 GB/s, plug into SXM2, Nvidia’s mezzanine socket for data center GPUs, rather than PCIe slots, and are split across two baseboards. Inside each board, all four cards are NVLinked — NVLink is Nvidia’s direct GPU-to-GPU link — for 128GB per board, but the two boards only communicate over PCIe. Each board connects to the host through two PEX (PLX) switch cards over SlimSAS cables, four switches in all, with each switch handling two GPUs at PCIe 3.0 x8 speeds over its own x16 uplink.The given prices are already in the past, though: used V100 SXM2 32GB cards are now listed on eBay for about $900, more than double the roughly $400 apiece from the post, and listings suggest prices are still climbing. The system also already has some other necessary components: a Gigabyte Threadripper Pro motherboard with a 12-core 3945WX CPU to match, 8x 32GB DDR4 RDIMM, one NUMA node, and two PSUs, 2,800 W in total, are on separate regular office circuits. This is a real-world case for used data center hardware as a cheap route to getting lots of fast VRAM together in one place.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The server is currently in daily use for first-pass work on case files: it reads a folder of records, pulls out facts, dates, and numbers, summarizes them, and takes a first swing at routine drafting. “Nothing goes out the door without a real review,” which is a good human-in-the-loop policy in general. It also helps ensure privacy for cases where client files can’t be sent to a cloud or frontier model. RAG databases and tool calls are wired in; the operator can drive the system through a Discord-style interface over SSH, in this case from a Windows PC. For now, it handles only one request at a time.DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is compressed to mostly 2 bits here, and its weights still total 248.8GB. The model’s “experts,” the parts that do most of the work for each word, live entirely in GPU memory, while about 110GB of lookup tables, called Engram tables, stay in the system’s regular RAM. Fetching from RAM costs about 0.12 milliseconds per step, which the builder says barely affects the speed numbers. You may like Reddit user pays $35 for a crypto mining rig left in a garage and gets 54GB of VRAM at 65 cents per GB Firm rents four Nvidia H200s to test '80x cheaper' DeepSeek claim Homelabber uses second-gen Optane memory sticks to run a 2.8-trillion-parameter AI model on CPU alone The first half of the model’s layers (0–19) runs on the first SXM2 board and the second half (20–39) on the second. Each board handles its heavy traffic over its own NVLink, so only one hand-off per step has to cross the slower PCIe link between the boards. In an earlier post, the builder found that splitting every layer across all eight cards made speeds “fall off a cliff” because of that PCIe hop.Performance is surprisingly good for a model this size. Code comes out fastest, at up to 215 tokens per second, because a small draft model built into DeepSeek guesses five tokens ahead, and code is easy to guess. Legal writing, which is what the server is for, runs at up to 118 tokens per second.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsLong documents take longer to get going: the model reads prompts at about 2,200 tokens per second, so at 128K tokens, the first token arrives after about a minute. It can accept up to 524K tokens of context. Three days before the post, the same model on four of these cards managed just 36–38 tokens per second. The jump came with the second board, which could presumably double performance under ideal circumstances, and the builder credits custom kernels and prefill work for the rest. See the table for the full breakdown. Swipe to scroll horizontally DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on eight Tesla V100s, by prompt length Prompt length Wait for first token Code (tokens/s) Legal writing (tokens/s) 1K tokens 1.2 seconds 215 118 32K tokens 17.2 seconds 200 117 128K tokens 59.2 seconds 183 111 256K tokens 118.7 seconds 160 103 Builder’s measurements, Nov. 5; greedy decoding, 1,024 tokens out, mean of two runs.It wasn’t as simple as hooking everything up and turning on the power. The host reset itself twice with a fatal PCIe error on the link to one GPU board, both times with a higher power limit and uncapped GPU clocks. In this state, the cards drew 192–232 W, past the 180 W limit. The best guess, although “not proven,” is that a board stops responding during load spikes. What to read next Nvidia PAIR utility joins every GPU in your home into a cluster for agentic AI tasks Beijing AI bar that offers unlimited free DeepSeek coding tokens with $1.50 drink haemorrhaging cash Benchmarking Qwen 3.8 27B on RTX 5090 and beyond The resets stopped after the builder capped the clocks and removed one board whose power connector had a burn mark; “Check your connectors, people.” Each card is now capped at 150 W, half of its 300 W rating, with the graphics clock capped at 1522 MHz. A 200 W cap brought no appreciable performance gains, according to tests.The system memory hit uncorrected ECC errors, too, which went away after the builder dropped the RAM from DDR4-3200 to DDR4-2666. One GPU was connected at x4 instead of x8 at last check, and the builder plans to reseat it; one commenter traced the same kind of problem on their own V100 to a bad cable.The pain was worth the payoff as an estimated 50–60% of the lawyer’s existing LLM workflows can now run on the box instead of frontier models. Helping bridge the gap is a second DeepSeek server on two DGX Sparks, where the two systems hand work off to each other. The setup does appear to save money, at least when compared to API pricing, although the builder says it’s not really faster. However, it will protect client data “once it is self contained, which is the goal.”The builder added that the V100 box might also get a 240 V circuit. Beyond power, the system is also on borrowed time with the Nvidia R580 driver branch, which is the last to support Volta. For now, the lawyer admits that it’s mostly a hobby, but in the future it may be a business idea. The next step is to handle two or three requests at once, something built and checked on a test system but not yet on the server. history.titleZh: 律师用八块二手Nvidia V100 GPU搭建私有AI服务器
history.descriptionZh:
一位律师在Reddit上分享了一套私有AI服务器：用八块2018年时代的二手Nvidia Tesla V100数据中心GPU搭建，目的是让案卷文件完全不离开办公室。这套系统由两块4卡SXM2 NVLink基板、四个PEX/PLX交换机以及大量SlimSAS线缆组成，搭建过程中还遇到过一个烧毁的电源连接器。它目前运行开源的DeepSeek V4.1 Flash模型，所有“专家”参数都放在GPU显存中，最高可达215 tokens/s。 builder购买时，每块四GPU基板约2400美元。

硬件方面，八块Tesla V100-SXM2-32GB每块拥有32GB HBM2显存和900 GB/s带宽。它们使用Nvidia面向数据中心GPU的SXM2夹层插槽，而不是PCIe插槽，并分装在两块基板上。每块基板内四块卡通过NVLink直连，每板聚合128GB显存；但两块基板之间只能通过PCIe通信。每块基板通过两个PEX交换机卡经SlimSAS连接主机，四个交换机各负责两块GPU，以PCIe 3.0 x8连接GPU、以x16上行连接主机。价格已经上涨：二手V100 SXM2 32GB在eBay上目前约900美元一块，比帖子中约400美元一块翻了一倍多，而且挂牌价仍在上涨。系统其余配置包括Gigabyte Threadripper Pro主板、12核3945WX CPU、8条32GB DDR4 RDIMM、一个NUMA节点，以及总功率2800W的两个电源，分别接在普通办公电路上。这是二手数据中心硬件作为低成本、大容量快速VRAM方案的一个真实案例。

这套服务器目前每天用于案卷初筛：读取记录文件夹，提取事实、日期和数字，生成摘要，并对常规文书起草给出初稿。所有输出都要经过人工复核，这既是良好的“人在回路”策略，也能确保客户文件不被发送到云端或前沿模型。系统接入了RAG数据库和工具调用，操作者可通过SSH上的Discord风格界面从Windows PC驱动。目前它一次只处理一个请求。

模型方面，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash被压缩到以2比特为主，权重仍有248.8GB。模型中负责每个词大部分计算的“专家”部分完全驻留在GPU显存中，约110GB的查找表“Engram tables”则留在系统内存；从内存取数据每步约0.12毫秒，builder称几乎不影响速度。模型前半部分第0—19层跑在第一块SXM2基板上，后半部分第20—39层跑在第二块基板上。每块基板内部的重流量走自己的NVLink，因此每步只有一次交接需要跨过较慢的板间PCIe。此前builder发现，如果把每一层都拆分到八块卡上，速度会因为PCIe跳转而“断崖式下降”。

性能相当可观。代码生成最快可达215 tokens/s，因为DeepSeek内置的小型草稿模型会向前猜五个token，而代码容易猜中；法律写作最高118 tokens/s。长文档的启动较慢：模型读取提示词约2200 tokens/s，因此在128K tokens时首token约需一分钟；它最多可接受524K tokens上下文。三天前，同一模型在四块卡上只有36—38 tokens/s；加上第二块基板后性能跳升，理想情况下可能翻倍，builder将剩余提升归功于自定义kernel和prefill优化。按其测量，在1K、32K、128K、256K提示长度下，首token等待分别约1.2、17.2、59.2、118.7秒，代码吞吐为215、200、183、160 tokens/s，法律写作为118、117、111、103 tokens/s；测试采用贪心解码、输出1024 tokens、两次运行平均。

搭建并非即插即用。主机曾两次因连接某块GPU基板的PCIe链路发生致命错误而重启，两次都发生在提高功耗上限并解除GPU时钟限制时；此时显卡功耗达到192—232W，超过180W限制。builder猜测，但未证实，是负载尖峰时基板停止响应。在限制时钟并移除一块电源连接器有烧痕的基板后，重启停止；他提醒“检查你的连接器”。现在每块卡功耗上限设为150W，为其300W额定值的一半，图形时钟上限1522MHz；测试表明200W上限没有明显性能收益。系统内存还出现过不可纠正ECC错误，将RAM从DDR4-3200降到DDR4-2666后消失。上次检查时一块GPU以x4而非x8连接，builder计划重新插拔；有评论者称自己在V100上遇到同类问题，原因是坏线缆。

这套系统的价值在于：估计现有LLM工作流中有50%—60%可以在这台机器上运行，而不是调用前沿模型。另有一套由两台DGX Spark组成的第二DeepSeek服务器，两套系统会互相交接工作。相比API定价，这套方案看起来能省钱，但builder表示它并不真的更快；不过一旦实现自包含，就能保护客户数据，这是目标。V100机器还可能接入240V电路。除功耗外，系统还面临Nvidia R580驱动分支这一最后支持Volta的版本，未来支持时间有限。目前这主要是一项爱好，但未来可能成为商业想法；下一步是同时处理两到三个请求，相关功能已在测试系统上构建和检查，但尚未部署到服务器。

history.title: China builds massive 800-megawatt AI data center campus to rival US Stargate project
history.description: Envision has delivered the first 120MW of its Galaxy AI datacenter in less than a year, combining wind farms, battery storage and an unconventional cooling system to cut costs and keep power-hungry servers running
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter China is building an 800MW AI data center campus in Inner Mongolia that could challenge the economics of America's Stargate project, according to a new report from SemiAnalysis. Envision has built the first 120 MW of Galaxy AI data center campus in less than a year, a cost the researchers put at just one-fifth of comparable US projects, after visiting the site in September.But getting the buildings up is only half of the battle. AI data centers need enormous amounts of electricity, and Envision is taking an unusual route to secure it— building its own wind farms and battery storage alongside the computing facility.While US developers are turning to on-site gas turbines to work around grid constraints, Envision is building its data center alongside wind farms, battery storage, and dedicated power infrastructure. Galaxy is located in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, and is being developed across four phases for two unnamed internet companies. The completed campus is planned to provide up to 800MW of IT capacity by the end of 2027, putting it closer to the approximately 820MW of critical IT capacity at the Stargate campus in Abilene, Texas.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Envision is building its own power supply for Galaxy rather than leaving everything to the local grid. So far, the company has installed more than 100GW of wind turbines and wants its wind farms to provide over 60% of the electricity needed by the campus’s first two phases. Those farms, located about 80 kilometers apart, have a combined capacity of 420MW. That's well above the 240MW load expected from the first two phases, although wind turbines rarely get to run flat out. Ulanqab’s wind capacity factor is between 355 and 40%, so Envision is adding four-hour battery storage to keep the electricity coming when the wind dies down. (Image credit: SemiAnalysis)Power equipment is proving rather hard to come by for some US data center builders. We have previously reported on turbine shortages that have pushed delivery estimates to 2030, while SpaceX is looking to manufacture its own turbine blades for its gas-powered AI facilities. Envision, meanwhile, is putting wind generation and battery storage right alongside its servers. You may like China deploys 'world's first' 800-volt DC power system for massive AI data center China shifting massive AI data center complexes to rural provinces to tap surplus energy SpaceX's plan to build more data center compute than Google's entire lifetime capacity in just 1.5 years is possible, say analysts The power hardware inside the Galaxy is worth a look, too. Semianalyss visited a 5MW hall where solid-state transformers take 10kV AC electricity and convert it directly into 800V DC for the server racks. That's a fairly substantial departure from conventional data-center power distribution, which typically involves several intermediate conversion stages. “In one 5MW hall, we saw the 800V system at work,” the researchers wrote. They explained that “Solid-state transformers (SSTs) take 10kV AC from the grid and convert it straight to 800V DC for the racks.”The design removes several intermediate components found in conventional data center power systems, including low voltage transformers, uninterruptible power supplies and rectifiers. Fewer conversion stages can reduce equipment requirements and energy losses, although SemiAnalysis did not provide a measured efficiency improvement for Galaxy’s pilot. The 5MW installation is only a small part of the campus, but it puts the technology into operation at a live facility. Envision, however, plans an even larger deployment in the next construction phases, a move that aligns with Nvidia's push for 800V DC distribution in future high-density AI systems.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsGalaxy's campus uses a cooling arrangement in which liquid-cooled and air-cooled servers share a single water loop, eliminating the need for conventional central chiller plants. That matters as AI servers generate more heat and require increasingly sophisticated cooling systems. Removing central chillers can simplify infrastructure, although the design depends on local climate conditions and the facility's ability to reject heat through its water loop. China has previously experimented with other unconventional cooling methods, including a wind-powered underwater datacenter off Shanghai that uses surrounding seawater to help cool its servers.That said, Galaxy is the first major project in Invision's wider Inner Mongolia datacentre plans, which Semianalysis says add up to 3GW, with the rest of the campus still a busy construction site. The surrounding Chahar High-tech Zone is also expanding rapidly, with nearly 30,000 construction workers spread across 22 data center projects, according to a local report cited by the researchers.The wider Chinese expansion is also attracting some of the world's largest technology companies. Alibaba, Huawei and ByteDance are among the firms expanding infrastructure in the region, which benefits from relatively cheap electricity, available land and abundant wind resources. However access to electricity and datacenter buildings does not automatically translate to available AI computing power. China's access to advanced accelerators remains a separate constraint, particularly as US export restrictions limit its ability to acquire Nvidia’s most powerful chips. history.titleZh: 中国打造800兆瓦大型AI数据中心园区，对标美国“星际之门”项目
history.descriptionZh:
中国内蒙古正在建设一座规划IT容量最高达800MW的AI数据中心园区“Galaxy”，其开发方远景科技集团（Envision）计划以自建风电、储能和新型供电架构，挑战美国“Stargate”项目的经济性。SemiAnalysis在9月实地考察后发布的报告称，Galaxy首期120MW设施在不到一年内建成，建设成本仅为美国同类项目的约五分之一。项目位于乌兰察布，分四期开发，服务于两家未具名互联网公司，全部建成后计划到2027年底提供最高800MW IT容量，接近得克萨斯州阿比林Stargate园区约820MW的关键IT容量。这意味着中国在AI基础设施的规模、建设速度和成本控制上，正形成与美国超大规模AI数据中心相竞争的能力。

AI数据中心的核心瓶颈之一是电力。与部分美国开发商在电网约束下采用现场燃气轮机不同，远景选择为数据中心配套自建风电、电池储能和专用电力基础设施。报告称，远景迄今已在全球安装超过100GW风电机组；Galaxy前两期所需电力中，风电预计提供60%以上。为园区供能的风电场相距约80公里，合计容量420MW，高于前两期预计240MW负载。不过乌兰察布风电容量因子约为35%—40%，风机难以持续满发，因此项目配置了4小时电池储能，在风力下降时维持供电。这种“数据中心+新能源+储能”的模式，把发电资源与算力设施直接绑定，减少对当地电网的依赖，也利用内蒙古廉价电力、可用土地和丰富风资源。

在供电硬件上，Galaxy采用了不同于传统数据中心的架构。SemiAnalysis考察了一个5MW机房：固态变压器（SST）将电网10kV交流电直接转换为800V直流电，供服务器机架使用。传统数据中心通常需要多级转换，包括低压变压器、不间断电源（UPS）和整流器等；Galaxy的设计去除多项中间设备，理论上可减少设备需求和能量损耗，但报告未给出该试点机房实测效率提升数据。5MW系统目前只是园区一小部分，却已在真实设施中运行。远景计划在后续建设阶段扩大部署，这与Nvidia推动未来高密度AI系统采用800V直流配电的方向一致。

冷却方面，Galaxy让液冷服务器和风冷服务器共享同一水环路，取消传统中央冷水机组。随着AI服务器功率和发热量上升，冷却系统日益关键；去除中央冷机可简化基础设施，但该设计依赖当地气候条件以及设施通过水环路排热的能力。中国此前还探索过非常规冷却方式，例如上海附近利用海水冷却的风电水下数据中心。Galaxy是远景在内蒙古更大数据中心计划中的首个大型项目。SemiAnalysis称，远景在内蒙古的相关规划合计达3GW，园区其余部分仍是繁忙工地。周边察哈尔高新技术开发区也在快速扩张，当地报道称22个数据中心项目共有近3万名施工人员。

这一轮扩张吸引了阿里巴巴、华为、字节跳动等中国大型科技企业。该地区具备相对低廉的电价、可用土地和丰富风能资源。但报告也指出，获得电力和数据中心建筑并不自动等于拥有可用AI算力。中国获取先进加速器仍受独立约束，尤其是美国出口限制削弱其获得Nvidia最强芯片的能力。因此，Galaxy和内蒙古集群的意义不仅在于以新能源和新型直流供电降低AI数据中心成本、提升建设速度，也反映出在中美AI竞赛中，中国正试图以能源基础设施、建设效率和系统集成能力弥补高端芯片供应受限带来的短板。

history.titleZh: 现在以历史最低价399.99美元入手AMD最快的主流游戏CPU
history.descriptionZh:
AMD目前在游戏CPU市场占据主导地位。虽然Ryzen 7 9800X3D并非AMD产品线中绝对性能最强的型号，但凭借出色的性能功耗比，它仍被视为游戏玩家的最佳选择之一。当前该处理器在多家零售商处降至399.99美元的历史新低，不过需要应用优惠券：Newegg结账时使用优惠码BFF36可减70美元，Amazon则需点击价格下方49.01美元优惠券。

Ryzen 7 9800X3D采用AMD当前Zen 5架构，为8核16线程，加速频率5.2GHz，TDP 120W，并且完全解锁，可进行超频——这改善了AMD早期3D V-Cache芯片在超频方面的限制。其核心技术在于额外的大容量L3缓存：该芯片配备96MB L3缓存，并通过重新配置的芯片布局，将缓存堆叠在CPU核心下方、更靠近均热板的位置。这种设计使游戏性能显著受益，尤其适合对CPU敏感的负载。

性能对比方面，定位更高的Ryzen 7 9850X3D在1080p下仅比9800X3D快约3%，但功耗需求高出约30%。因此，9800X3D在每瓦性能上表现更优，可在不大幅增加功耗的情况下最大化游戏性能。基准测试显示，9800X3D处于CPU性能榜前列；搭配较新的显卡时瓶颈较少，若与RTX 5080或RTX 5090等高端GPU组合，可在各类游戏中实现高帧率。对于《赛博朋克2077》这类CPU密集型游戏，96MB L3缓存也能提供有力支持。

从市场影响看，Intel目前缺少能与之正面竞争的同类产品，因此9800X3D预计在较长时间内不会过时，并可能在未来数年继续主导游戏CPU市场。AMD的AM5平台仍在延续，AMD承诺至少再支持一代。对于现有AM5游戏PC升级或新装机用户，这两款X3D处理器都是颇具吸引力的核心选择。

此外，9850X3D也在促销：Newegg售价419美元，需使用优惠码BFF39减65美元；Amazon可通过页面优惠券获得同等价格。该型号同样基于Zen 5架构，8核16线程，加速频率5.6GHz，配备96MB 3D V-Cache。相比其484美元的发售价，当前419美元相当于明显降价。整体来看，9800X3D以399美元的历史低价提供极佳游戏性能功耗比，而9850X3D则以约3%的额外性能满足追求更高频率的用户。
